svg.title: Visualization tree
svg.desc: Scatter plot, colored by group (Plot and layout, Marks, 3D marks, Data sources, Transforms, Inputs), with labels and segments. x from -10 to 10, y from -6.2 to -0.8. 33 points.

g.style: fill: rgb(37, 37, 37); stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; font: 400 10px "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; opacity: 1; color: rgb(37, 37, 37);
